title: Edgeware Recovery Plan
body:
First of all, I must thank all of the Edgeware Community members for accepting my proposals. I've gained a lot of experience in the last six months by experimenting with projects in Edgeware Blockchain. After getting rejected by many VCs and Exchanges for my projects, Edgeware gave me new hope, and now I am planning to launch my Neo Bank and On-Demand Delivery Super App in India in Q1 of 2023. I mentioned Finn Exchange, a derivative trading platform, in my first proposal, but it didn't go well because liquidity is very important for the concept and no one is ready to invest. I paused that project and created a substrate blockchain, which supports real-world project integration. I am focusing on getting normal users first before integrating blockchain. I will raise funds for these projects only after getting 50-100k active users in India. Maybe with the Edgestarter launchpad as well, if the community approves my project. Many projects raise funds with MVP, but I will use real-time data to raise funds. Having this type of product in the IDO portfolio will be good.

I have 2 registered companies in India. You can verify [here](https://www.zaubacorp.com/director/BHARATH-BILLAVARA-RAMESH/08805150), or you can use the DIN number or full name to search information on Google or the official MCA portal.

With the price of Edgeware falling, this blockchain network is completely reliant on Treasury funds. Beginning of the year Treasury funds was almost worth 5m not its around 
I can see the failed proposals, and more cuts will be coming to save the Treasury funds. I personally don’t want to see Edgeware as another ghost chain, so I am sharing some of my own ideas to make Edgeware great again.
